name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
summary: Provides free LPG (cooking gas) connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to replace traditional cooking fuels like firewood, coal, and dung cakes.
summary_hi: गरीबी रेखा से नीचे (बीपीएल) परिवारों की महिलाओं को पारंपरिक खाना पकाने के ईंधन (लकड़ी, कोयला, गोबर के उपले) के स्थान पर मुफ्त एलपीजी (रसोई गैस) कनेक्शन प्रदान करती है।
benefits: Free LPG connection to eligible BPL households
First LPG cylinder and stove (hotplate) provided free of cost
Subsequent refills available at market price with option for PAHAL subsidy
Reduces health hazards from indoor air pollution caused by traditional cooking methods
Empowers women by saving time spent collecting firewood

who_can_apply: Adult woman (above 18 years) from a BPL household
Household not already having an LPG connection
Woman must be a voter in the same state where connection is sought
Ration card holder under NFSA (National Food Security Act)
who_cannot_apply: Households already having an LPG connection
documents_required: Aadhaar card of the applicant woman
Bank account details (optional, for subsidy transfer)

how_to_apply: Visit the nearest HPCL/IOCL/BPCL LPG distributor (gas agency)
Submit Aadhaar, BPL card, and voter ID
The distributor verifies eligibility through the PMUY portal (https://pmuy.gov.in)
After verification, the connection is issued within 7-10 working days
First cylinder and stove are delivered to your home

faq.q: I have an old LPG connection — can I still apply?
faq.a: No. PMUY is only for households that do not already have an LPG connection.

faq.q: Do I get free gas refills forever?
faq.a: Only the first cylinder is free. After that, you pay market price. If eligible, you can get PAHAL subsidy for up to 12 cylinders per year.

faq.q: Can a male member apply on behalf of a woman?
faq.a: The connection is issued in the name of the adult woman of the household. She must apply in person or through proper authorization.

faq.q: What if I lost my connection documents?
faq.a: Visit your LPG distributor with your Aadhaar card. They can look up the connection in the system and issue duplicate documents.
